common.guild_only: This only works inside a server, not in direct messages.
common.unexpected: Something went wrong on my side. Please try again — I have logged the details.
common.busy: You have an action still running. Give it a second and try again.

panel.title: Quran Radio
panel.not_configured: No voice channel is set up yet. Run `/setup radio` to pick one, then `/control` to open the panel.
panel.panel_sent: Control panel is up. Use the buttons there to play, pause and switch stations.

errors.not_configured: No voice channel is set up for the radio yet. An admin can run `/setup radio` to pick one.
errors.channel_missing: The voice channel I was set to use is gone. An admin can run `/setup radio` to pick a new one.
errors.channel_full: {channel} is full, so I cannot get in. Raise its user limit or free up a slot and try again.
errors.missing_permissions: I need {permissions} in {channel} before I can play there.
errors.not_in_voice: Join the voice channel first, then you can control the radio.
errors.wrong_voice: You need to be in {channel} to control the radio.
errors.audio_server_unreachable: The audio server is not responding, so I cannot start playback. Playback resumes by itself once it is back.
errors.station_failed: This station is not responding right now. I keep retrying it, or you can pick another one from the menu.
errors.cant_connect: I could not join the voice channel. Check my permissions there and try again.
errors.no_stations: I could not find that station in my list. Pick one from the menu instead.
errors.cannot_post_panel: I cannot post here. I need View Channel and Send Messages in this channel.
errors.audio_server_auth: The audio server refused my credentials, so playback cannot start. `AUDIO_SERVER_TOKEN` needs to match on both processes.

errors.channel_not_found: I could not find that channel. Pick it again from the menu.
errors.not_voice_channel: {channel} is not a voice channel. Pick a voice channel for the radio.
errors.not_text_channel: {channel} is not a text channel. Pick a text channel for messages.
errors.already_set: {channel} is already the one I am using. Nothing to change.
errors.missing_permissions: I need {permissions} in {channel}. Grant them and pick the channel again.
errors.radio_moved: The radio was playing in the old channel, so I stopped it. Turn it back on from `/control`.

success.radio_channel_set: The radio will play in {channel}. Open `/control` to start it and choose a station.
success.azkar_channel_set: Adhkar will be posted in {channel}. Choose the categories and interval below, then switch it on.
success.prayer_channel_set: Prayer times will be posted in {channel}. Pick the country and city below, then switch it on.

quick.title: Quick Setup
quick.intro: This creates everything the bot needs in one go. Nothing has been created yet - review it first.
quick.prayer_default: Prayer times default to **Cairo, Egypt** and can be changed later from `/setup prayer`.
quick.tip_missing_some: I am missing the permissions marked with a cross. Grant them before confirming, or channel creation will fail partway.
quick.security_warning: **A security / anti-nuke bot is in this server** ({bots}). Quick setup creates several channels within seconds, which those bots often treat as an attack. Whitelist me there first, or I may be kicked mid-setup.
quick.existing_intro: This server already has these services set up:
quick.existing_replace: **Replace setup** overwrites the saved settings with the new channels. The old channels are left in place - delete them yourself if you no longer want them.
quick.not_your_button: Only the person who ran the command can use these buttons.
quick.cancelled: Quick setup cancelled. Nothing was created.
quick.done_body: Created {count} channels, saved the settings, and started the radio, adhkar and prayer schedules. You can change any of it from `/control`, `/setup azkar` and `/setup prayer`.
quick.failed_nothing_saved: No settings were saved, so nothing is half-configured. Fix the cause, delete the channels that were created if you do not want them, then run `/setup quick` again.
quick.need_manage_guild: Quick setup needs the Manage Server permission.

manager.denied: This is not available to you.
manager.invalid_id: `{id}` is not a valid Discord ID. IDs are 17 to 20 digits.
manager.mod_not_found: `{id}` is not in the mods list, so there was nothing to remove.
manager.mod_is_owner: `{id}` is an owner. Owners are managed in config.json, not here.
manager.reset_not_found: I am not in any server with the ID `{id}`.
manager.reset_item_prayer: Prayer settings and its scheduled adhan
manager.reset_keeps_membership: I will **not** leave the server - it can run `/setup` again at any time.
manager.reset_nothing: That server has no saved data, so there is nothing to reset.

lang.title: Bot language
lang.choose: Choose the language the bot uses in this server.
lang.changed: I will use **{name}** in this server from now on.
lang.no_permission: Only someone with Manage Server can change my language. Ask an admin to run `/lang`.
lang.prompt_tip: I am speaking **{name}** in this server. An admin can change that here or with `/lang`.
lang.default_note: No language has been chosen for this server yet, so the bot is using English.
